question: How many shares did Casey's General Stores repurchase in its fiscal first quarter of 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), at what total cost and average price per share, and how much repurchase authorization remained at quarter end?
grading: Key points: 54,647 shares repurchased in the quarter; total cost about USD 45.6M (45,642 thousand per the equity statement; accept USD 44.9M-45.7M if cash-flow basis is explained); average price USD 835.19; maximum dollar value remaining under the program USD 972.6M (972,601,128), after the Board expanded the program to USD 1.0B on June 4, 2026. Tolerance +/-0.5%. Fail if a prior-year quarter is used.
answer: In fiscal Q1 2027 (May 1-July 31, 2026) Casey's repurchased 54,647 shares at an average price of USD 835.19 (monthly: 18,696 at USD 842.06; 17,386 at USD 814.82; 18,565 at USD 847.35), a total cost of about USD 45.6 million (USD 45,642 thousand in the statement of shareholders' equity; cash paid incl. excise taxes USD 44.9 million). USD 972.6 million (972,601,128) remained under the repurchase program at July 31, 2026, after the Board expanded the program from USD 400 million to USD 1.0 billion on June 4, 2026 [H09-E1].
